verses.html: 22 When they arrived at Bethsaida, some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.
verses.text: 22 When they arrived at Bethsaida, some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.

verses.html: 23 So He took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. Then He spit on the man’s eyes and placed His hands on him. “Can you see anything?” He asked.
verses.text: 23 So He took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. Then He spit on the man’s eyes and placed His hands on him. “Can you see anything?” He asked.

verses.html: 24 The man looked up and said, “I can see the people, but they look like trees walking around.”
verses.text: 24 The man looked up and said, “I can see the people, but they look like trees walking around.”

verses.html: 25 Once again Jesus placed His hands on the man’s eyes, and when he opened them his sight was restored, and he could see everything clearly.
verses.text: 25 Once again Jesus placed His hands on the man’s eyes, and when he opened them his sight was restored, and he could see everything clearly.

verses.html: 26 Jesus sent him home and said, “Do not go back into the village.”

verses.html: 22 After that, Jesus and his apprentices arrived at the town of Bethsaida. The people there took a blind man to Jesus. They urged Jesus to {heal the man} by touching him.
verses.text: 22 After that, Jesus and his apprentices arrived at the town of Bethsaida. The people there took a blind man to Jesus. They urged Jesus to {heal the man} by touching him.

verses.html: 23 So, Jesus took one of the blind man’s hands. He brought the blind man outside the town. Then Jesus spat saliva onto the man’s eyes, and Jesus touched him. After that, he asked the man, “Can you see anything?”
verses.text: 23 So, Jesus took one of the blind man’s hands. He brought the blind man outside the town. Then Jesus spat saliva onto the man’s eyes, and Jesus touched him. After that, he asked the man, “Can you see anything?”

verses.html: 24 So, the man looked around. He said, “{Yes,} I can see people! They look like trees, but I can tell that they are walking around.”
verses.text: 24 So, the man looked around. He said, “{Yes,} I can see people! They look like trees, but I can tell that they are walking around.”

verses.html: 25 After that, Jesus again touched the blind man’s eyes. When the man looked around carefully, he could see everything properly. Jesus had cured him!
verses.text: 25 After that, Jesus again touched the blind man’s eyes. When the man looked around carefully, he could see everything properly. Jesus had cured him!
